description: After the koala-removal ship-clean program completed (B-40eb/B-0dab/B-e7c6), CHANGELOG.md still uses the Koala brand. It was originally a documented exception (truthful history), but the user chose to fully rebrand it: all koala/Koala/KOALA -> lattice/Lattice/LATTICE, including historical technical tokens. CHANGELOG is excluded from the koala-residue gate, so this is a pure-docs change with no code/test impact.
